recovery_posting_design.receipt: sale recovery = actual bank received + approved invoice-backed withheld bill clearances - customer excess. Only actual bank amount is a bank movement. Withholding clears existing AP without recognising another expense or recording a fake bank payment.
recovery_posting_design.refund: Excess customer money is a reserved liability. Actual receipt-backed customer refund reduces bank and liability equally, with zero car-profit effect. Need source-bound immutable documents and idempotent cash link.
recovery_posting_design.tradeIn: Gross incoming value minus lender balance is the noncash sale credit. Same-pot re-investment has zero net ownership movement and needs liquidity for the lender settlement. A different investor/company pot needs full gross available funding; net credit moves ownership to the outgoing pot, lender balance remains payable. No fake bank transfer. Negative equity requires explicit review.
